method.concept: Four feature pools representing register discontinuity at word boundaries

evidence.evidence: From each of the stylizations four feature pools were induced representing different aspects of register discontinuity at word boundaries: discontinuities related to the base-, mid-, and topline, as well as to the range between base- and topline.

method.concept: Generalized linear regression models for boundary strength prediction

evidence.evidence: We furthermore trained generalized linear regression models for boundary strength prediction on each feature pool.
